item.title: Life and work of Bernard LaFayette remembered throughout Alabama
item.description: Bernard LaFayette, a key figure in Selma who helped efforts that led to the passage of the Voting Rights Act of 1965, has died at 85, just days before he was to be honored at the Martin & Coretta King Unity Breakfast.

item.title: Equal Justice Initiative opens Montgomery Square
item.description: The Montgomery-based Equal Justice Initiative has opened Montgomery Square, its latest Legacy Site downtown.

item.title: Baptist Health goes blue for Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month
item.description: Colorectal cancer is the leading cause of cancer death for men under 50 and the second for women in that age group.

item.title: Life of Rev. Jesse Jackson remembered at funeral in Chicago
item.description: From former presidents to an NBA Hall of Famer to prominent church pastors, stories of the Rev. Jesse Jackson’s influence on politics, corporate boardrooms and picket lines loomed large at a celebration honoring the late civil rights leader, who was a familiar presence in Alabama over the years.

item.title: Man seriously hurt in shooting on Norman Bridge Road in Montgomery
item.description: Montgomery police are investigating a shooting on Norman Bridge Road that left a man seriously hurt.

item.title: Periods Of Rain/T-storms This Weekend
item.description: Some storms could be strong to possibly severe late Saturday afternoon into the evening hours!

item.title: Faulkner University dedicates new mental health center
item.description: Faulkner University has formally dedicated its new Faulkner Mental Health Center with a ribbon-cutting and dedication ceremony.

item.title: Man faces drug charges after chase in Tallapoosa County
item.description: A Dadeville man faces drug trafficking charges following a chase in Tallapoosa County.

item.title: ACTION 8 UPDATE: Jury chosen for capital murder trial of Ibraheem Yazeed
item.description: A jury has now been selected for the capital murder trial of Ibraheem Yazeed of Montgomery, who's charged with killing 19-year-old college student Aniah Blanchard in 2019.

item.title: Hyundai Power Transformers breaks ground on its newest expansion
item.description: Hyundai Power Transformers USA, a long-time manufacturer in Montgomery, is growing its operation even more. The company is breaking ground on their newest $200 million expansion, bringing 200 jobs to the Capital City.
